draft.title: Mars trine Lilith
draft.humanMoment: A museum covers a photograph before opening night, and the artist tears down the screen as guests enter.
draft.developmentDetail: Other contributors uncover their own works while security replaces the barriers and visitors film the confrontation.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Mars carries security's sanctioned force to control the exhibition, while Lilith carries the artists' rage at being censored and their refusal to be made acceptable.
draft.aspectMechanic: Under the trine, replacing the barriers and tearing them down reinforce each other with little resistance, letting the confrontation spread through the exhibition before museum directors reconsider the decision.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If security keeps restoring the barriers as contributors remove them, the opening can close early and leave the museum facing a broader dispute over whose work it tries to tame.

judge.weakest: If security keeps restoring the barriers as contributors remove them, the opening can close early and leave the museum facing a broader dispute over whose work it tries to tame.
judge.why: The consequence is slightly more interpretive than the other fields, but it follows directly from the escalating confrontation and preserves the Mars-Lilith conflict.
